Name: CS_WATER_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Water surface settings for each level of the Water Surface Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Water Interaction Enabled
Fields.Description: Enables interactive water surface effects. Retail: off on Off and Low.
